primary_reviews.fulltext_review_scope: Necessary original sections 4.2.1, 4.2.3-4.2.7, 4.3.2-4.3.6, Data availability, and Code availability; not a claim of line-by-line proof checking of every appendix.
defining_method: Sections 4.2.3-4.2.4 define an action-conditioned second-order latent transition: delta_z_t=z_t-z_(t-1), predicted_z_(t+1)=z_t+g(z_t,a_t)delta_z_t. Encoder hidden size is 256 and latent size 128. Rollout and path losses use jointly encoded observed targets; an EMA/stop-gradient teacher is not asserted.
The first two observed states initialize recursive future rollout. A post-hoc decoder operates on the frozen learned dynamics. Future observed physiological states are not supplied as rollout inputs.

Section 4.3.2 Eq55 defines personalized quadratic action effort using baseline variability and specified minimum variability floors. Eq56 ranks externally predicted future-versus-future CHA benefits by benefit/(1+effort), filters benefits at or below 0.1 years, and returns at most three feasible sleep/movement/combined pathways.
primary_reviews.permitted_low_cost_boundary: Only exact Eq55-Eq56 deterministic CPU planning postprocessing over explicitly external model predictions is selected. It is not a SensorWM encoder/dynamics reproduction, an inferred 125-grid generator, a clinical safety validator, or an agent/clinical capability result. The source/action-versus-outcome separation must remain explicit.
primary_reviews.evaluation_and_causality_boundary: Original comparisons are retrospective/offline: 49 profiles with ten expert raters, and 2,613 evaluable paired plans from a 2,780-person cohort with repeated LLM judging. Observational conditional projections are not identified causal intervention effects, clinical efficacy, or production A/B evidence.

cost_evidence.detail: 96,957 participants; 2.28 million private longitudinal Fitbit person-weeks; 182,797 valid 12-week windows.
Learned encoder/dynamics, recursive multi-step objectives, AdamW and decoder fitting; GPU count, total time, epochs, and batch size are not disclosed and are not invented.
Gemini 3.5 Flash generation, repeated judge evaluation and expert review add external-model and human evaluation cost.
Longitudinal Fitbit records are not publicly redistributable; All of Us and WEAR-ME access is approved/registered-researcher access rather than unrestricted downloadable data.
